Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: Reimbursement amount exceeds the standard limit: According to the 'Reimbursement_Standard_college.xlsx' , for a Lecturer traveling within Western Europe (Eurozone) on a high-speed train for ≤3 hours, the maximum reimbursable single fare is €70 (Second Class). The submitted ticket from Firenze to Napoli (28 Oct 2024, travel time 12:28–15:28, exactly 3 hours) costs €79.90. This exceeds the standard by €9.90. Therefore the full amount cannot be reimbursed; the maximum eligible amount is €70.
